abort.already_configured: This nook server is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new API key works. The integration reloads with it.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the nook server. Check the URL and that the server is up.
error.invalid_auth: The server refused the API key, or the key's scope does not allow this.
error.invalid_url: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

data_description.api_key: A "Play and browse" key from the nook admin console: System > API access (/admin/system).

reauth_confirm.description: The nook server at {url} refused the API key. Enter a new one.
reauth_confirm.title: New API key

data_description.api_key: A "Play and browse" key from the nook admin console: System > API access (/admin/system). Name it "Home Assistant": the TV shows that name as the sender.
data_description.url: The address of the nook server, for example https://nook.example.com

user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your nook server. Every paired nook TV becomes a media player.
user.title: Connect to nook

auth_failed.message: The nook server refused the API key. Enter a new key in the integration.

browse_failed.message: Could not load this list from nook: {error}

control_failed.message: nook could not control the TV: {error}

invalid_media_id.message: "{media_id}" is not a nook media id. A film or show looks like nook://stremio/movie/tt1160419, a channel like nook://live/<channel id>, music like nook://music/playlist/<id>; a TV link starts with nook://open. The integration's README lists every form.

link_refused.message: The nook server refused the link {link}: {error}

no_linked_remote.message: {name} has no linked Android TV Remote entity. Link one in the integration options to turn it on from Home Assistant.

no_match.message: nook found nothing to play for "{title}".

not_playable.message: "{media_id}" is a folder of the media browser, not something to play.

server_unsupported.message: This nook server is too old for Live TV, radio, music and Stop / Pause from Home Assistant. Update the nook server.

track_not_playable.message: "{media_id}" is a song without an album. Play it from a playlist, an artist or Liked songs.

tv_not_found.message: nook no longer knows the TV {name}.

tv_offline.message: {name} is offline. Open nook on the TV, or link its Android TV Remote entity in the integration options.

update_failed.message: Could not update from the nook server: {error}

wake_timeout.message: {name} was turned on but nook did not come online within {seconds} seconds.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant asks the server what the TVs play, in seconds.

init.description: Below the poll interval is one field per nook TV: pick its Android TV Remote entity (from the Android TV Remote integration). A TV with a linked remote can be turned on from Home Assistant, and a title sent to it while it is off wakes it first.
init.title: nook options

play_title.description: Searches nook for a title and plays the first hit on the TV. The TV picks the stream itself and resumes where you left off.

source.description: Only take a hit from this source.
source.name: Source

type.description: Only take a film, or only a show.
type.name: Type

year.description: Only take a hit from this year.
year.name: Year

play_title.name: Play title
